name: ImageToVector
tagline: Convert PNG and JPG images to clean, editable SVG paths
description: ImageToVector traces PNG, JPG or WebP logos, icons, line art and illustrations into editable SVG in the browser. Three conversions a day are available without an account, up to 2000 px. Photographs and soft gradients are a poor fit. This is a tracer, not a generative AI vectorizer.
